cards.ex: She's working hard to secure a tenure track position at the university.
cards.exUz: U universitetda doimiy lavozimga ega bo'lish uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda doimiy lavozimga olib boradigan yo'l, ishlash davri.

cards.ex: Access to higher education is crucial for social mobility.
cards.exUz: Oliy ta'limga kirish ijtimoiy harakatchanlik uchun juda muhim.
cards.uzDef: Universitet yoki institutlarda olinadigan ta'lim.

cards.ex: He's currently pursuing undergraduate studies in engineering.
cards.exUz: Hozirda u muhandislik bo'yicha bakalavriatda o'qiyapti.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda bakalavr darajasini olish uchun o'qish.

cards.ex: She plans to continue with postgraduate studies after graduation.
cards.exUz: U o'qishni tugatgandan keyin magistraturada davom ettirmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Bakalavr darajasidan keyin olinadigan ta'lim.

cards.ex: The core curriculum includes courses in math, science, and humanities.
cards.exUz: Asosiy o'quv dasturiga matematika, fan va gumanitar fanlar kiradi.
cards.uzDef: Talabalar o'qishi shart bo'lgan asosiy fanlar ro'yxati.

cards.ex: I chose several elective courses in art history and philosophy.
cards.exUz: Men san'at tarixi va falsafa bo'yicha bir nechta tanlov fanlarini tanladim.
cards.uzDef: Talabalar o'zlari tanlab o'qishi mumkin bo'lgan fanlar.

cards.ex: Creating a positive learning environment is essential for student success.
cards.exUz: Ijobiy ta'lim muhitini yaratish talabalar muvaffaqiyati uchun zarurdir.
cards.uzDef: O'quv jarayoni sodir bo'ladigan joy va sharoitlar.

cards.ex: The course aims to develop students' critical thinking skills.
cards.exUz: Kurs talabalarning tanqidiy fikrlash qobiliyatlarini rivojlantirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Ma'lumotni tahlil qilish va baholash qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The researcher has a vast knowledge base in the field of genetics.
cards.exUz: Tadqiqotchining genetika sohasida keng bilimlar bazasi mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Odamning yoki sohaning to'plagan bilimlar majmui.

cards.ex: His academic performance has improved significantly this semester.
cards.exUz: Uning akademik ko'rsatkichi shu semestrda sezilarli darajada yaxshilandi.
cards.uzDef: Talabaning o'qishdagi muvaffaqiyati.

cards.ex: She belongs to the school of thought that emphasizes practical experience.
cards.exUz: U amaliy tajribaga urg'u beradigan maktabiga tegishli.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan mavzuda o'xshash fikrga ega bo'lgan odamlar guruhi.

cards.ex: The school's decision to offer scholarships set a precedent for other institutions.
cards.exUz: Maktabning stipendiyalar taklif qilish qarori boshqa muassasalar uchun o'rnak bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda qilinadigan ishlarga namuna bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The debate coach taught us how to think on our feet.
cards.exUz: Munozara murabbiyi bizni tezda fikrlashga o'rgatdi.
cards.uzDef: Tezda muammoni yechish yoki vaziyatga moslashish.

cards.ex: Students are expected to toe the line and follow the university's regulations.
cards.exUz: Talabalar universitet qoidalariga rioya qilishlari kutiladi.
cards.uzDef: Belgilangan qoidalarga yoki standartlarga qat'iy rioya qilish.

cards.ex: We didn't have a fixed agenda, we decided to play it by ear.
cards.exUz: Bizda aniq reja yo'q edi, biz vaziyatga qarab harakat qilishga qaror qildik.
cards.uzDef: Reja tuzmasdan, vaziyatga qarab harakat qilish.

cards.ex: There's a world of difference between theoretical knowledge and practical skills.
cards.exUz: Nazariy bilim va amaliy ko'nikmalar o'rtasida katta farq bor.
cards.uzDef: Ikkita narsa o'rtasida juda katta farq borligini bildiradi.

cards.ex: She needed to get a grip before giving her presentation.
cards.exUz: U taqdimot qilishdan oldin o'zini qo'lga olishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: O'z his-tuyg'ularini nazorat qilish, tinchlanish.

cards.ex: The magazine published a think piece on the future of education.
cards.exUz: Jurnal ta'limning kelajagi haqida tahliliy maqola chop etdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzu bo'yicha chuqur tahlil qiluvchi maqola.

cards.ex: The professor received a research grant to study climate change.
cards.exUz: Professor iqlim o'zgarishini o'rganish uchun tadqiqot granti oldi.
cards.uzDef: Tadqiqot loyihasini moliyalashtirish uchun beriladigan pul.

cards.ex: The university is known for its academic rigor and demanding courses.
cards.exUz: Universitet akademik qat'iyligi va talabchan kurslari bilan mashhur.
cards.uzDef: Ta'lim dasturining yuqori talablari va qiyinligi.

cards.ex: The student body represents a diverse range of backgrounds and cultures.
cards.exUz: Talabalar jamoasi turli xil kelib chiqish va madaniyatlarni aks ettiradi.
cards.uzDef: Bir o'quv muassasasidagi talabalarning umumiy soni.

cards.ex: She is a tenured professor of history at Yale University.
cards.exUz: U Yels universitetida tarix bo'yicha doimiy professordir.
cards.uzDef: Universitetda doimiy lavozimga ega bo'lgan professor.

cards.ex: I have to take issue with your interpretation of the data.
cards.exUz: Men sizning ma'lumotlarni talqin qilishingizga munosabat bildirishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaga rozi bo'lmaslik, qarshi chiqish.

cards.ex: He worked as a graduate assistant while pursuing his master's degree.
cards.exUz: U magistrlik darajasini olayotganda aspirant yordamchisi bo'lib ishladi.
cards.uzDef: Magistratura talabasi, professorga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: Her formative years were spent in a small rural town.
cards.exUz: Uning shakllanish yillari kichik qishloq shahrida o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsning rivojlanishida muhim bo'lgan yillar.

cards.ex: The company offers a fast track program for high-potential employees.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya yuqori salohiyatga ega xodimlar uchun tezlashtirilgan dastur taklif qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy dasturdan tezroq o'tishga imkon beradigan dastur.

cards.ex: The think tank published a report on education reform.
cards.exUz: Tahlil markazi ta'lim islohoti bo'yicha hisobot e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosat va ijtimoiy muammolarni o'rganuvchi tashkilot.

cards.ex: It takes a while to get your bearings when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish boshlaganingizda yo'nalishni aniqlash uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi vaziyatda o'z o'rnini topish, moslashish.

cards.ex: He studied under the tutelage of a renowned professor.
cards.exUz: U taniqli professor rahbarligida o'qidi.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir rahbarligi yoki nazorati ostida.

cards.ex: I need to read up on the latest research before the conference.
cards.exUz: Konferensiyadan oldin so'nggi tadqiqotlar haqida o'qib chiqishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror mavzu haqida ko'proq ma'lumot olish uchun o'qish.
